title: Numeric Units of Measure Obscurity
pattern: Passing raw numeric primitives as function arguments representing physical attributes without type-enforced units.
why_bad: It pushes semantic interpretation of the unit (e.g., Celsius vs. Fahrenheit, Kilograms vs. Pounds) into developer memory. Swapping units at compile-time is undetected, leading to severe computational errors at runtime.
detection: Function signatures with raw numeric parameters whose names imply physical measurements (`temp`, `speed`, `weight`, `length`) lacking unit types.
counterexample: Raw mathematical calculations where values are abstract scalers without associated physical dimensions.
source: *Domain Modeling made Functional* by Scott Wlaschin (p. 83); *The Pragmatic Programmer* (p. 54).
